response.sql: WITH acct AS (SELECT t.account_id AS account_id, a.frequency AS frequency, AVG(t.amount) AS avg_amount FROM trans t JOIN account a ON a.account_id = t.account_id GROUP BY t.account_id, a.frequency), freq AS (SELECT frequency, AVG(avg_amount) AS freq_avg FROM acct GROUP BY frequency) SELECT acct.account_id, acct.frequency, acct.avg_amount, acct.avg_amount / NULLIF(freq.freq_avg, 0) AS ratio FROM acct JOIN freq ON freq.frequency = acct.frequency ORDER BY ratio IS NULL, ratio DESC LIMIT 10
